name: Scissor Jump
steps: Stand in a staggered split stance with one foot forward, the other back, knees softly bent, and arms bent at your sides.
Drop slightly to load your legs, then jump explosively straight upward while swinging your arms.
Scissor your legs briskly in midair to swap your front and rear feet before landing.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees in the opposite split stance, immediately alternating sides on each jump.
tips: Land lightly and quietly to absorb impact through your hips and ankles.
Keep your torso upright and your gaze forward rather than looking down at your feet.
